findings.completion_order: Before reading a failed tracked response, original completion stays cleanup_pending. After consuming exact stream_error, original completion and retirement must be independently confirmed.
findings.native_contract: ManagedTransport public module is byte-identical to installed/published 0.21.2. No new history-independent native/deferred envelope or acknowledged reclamation frontier is supplied.
findings.tracked_cancellation: Abort, request_timeout and worker/body/owner-down still use abort and request_lifecycle_stop to release unread tracked responses.
findings.tracked_parser_error: SocketClient report_failure delegates sent streamed errors to lifecycle fail_response. Parser failures send their original error to the response then ask tracker to cancel other resources; the response stream alone remains tracked until consumption/cancellation.
findings.untracked_cancellation: The nil-tracker clause runs first and sends error rather than lifecycle stop, preserving legacy late-reader abort/deadline delivery.
